name: @scanupload/qr-code-generator-monorepo
description: Monorepo for ScanUpload QR Code Generator — core, React, vanilla, Vue, Angular, and Svelte framework packages.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/core && npm run build --workspace=packages/react && npm run build --workspace=packages/vanilla && npm run build --workspace=packages/vue && npm run build --workspace=packages/angular && npm run build --workspace=packages/svelte
scripts.build:react: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace=packages/react
scripts.build:vanilla: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace=packages/vanilla
scripts.build:vue: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace=packages/vue
scripts.build:angular: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace=packages/angular
scripts.build:svelte: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace=packages/svelte
scripts.build:nextjs: npm run build:react && npm run build --workspace=examples/nextjs-demo

author: Donald Asante
